paragraphs: On Monday morning, Leo came into the classroom in a red football shirt. The other children wore white shirts and dark blue shorts or skirts. Teacher Kim looked at him and smiled. "Good morning, Leo," she said with a pleasant smile. "Where is your school uniform?" The room was quiet, and everyone looked at Leo.

"I am sorry, Teacher Kim," said Leo. "My uniform is wet. My uniform is on the line at home." "Why is it wet?" asked Teacher Kim. "Somebody washed it last night," said Leo. "Who washed it?" asked Teacher Kim. "Somebody in my house," said Leo. "I don't know who." Mia put her hand over her mouth and tried not to laugh. It was a strange excuse, so Teacher Kim waited for a moment.

"Leo, please tell me the real reason," she said. Leo looked at his shoes. "I looked at my timetable," he said. "It says, Monday, sports shirt." "So I wore my football shirt." Teacher Kim took a paper from her desk. "This is the new timetable," she said. "Sports day is on Wednesday now." "Your old timetable is from last month." "Oh no," said Leo. "I never read the new one."

"It is a small mistake," said Teacher Kim, "but I need a form." She gave Leo a short form and a pen. The form began with "Dear Parent." "Write your name and the date," said Teacher Kim. "Then take it home, and remember to ask your mom to sign it." "Are you sure that she will sign?" asked Leo. "I am sure," said Teacher Kim with a smile. "A mistake is not a problem if you tell me what happened." Leo sat down next to Mia, and he wore the wrong shirt all day.

In the evening, Leo gave the form to Mom. "Somebody washed your uniform last night," said Mom with a smile. "That somebody was me, and it was dry this morning." Leo laughed and said, "Then one thing in my excuse was true!" Mom signed the form and put it in his bag. Then Leo put the new timetable on his wall.
text.summary: Leo comes to school in a football shirt and gives Teacher Kim an excuse. The real reason is a mistake with his old timetable.
